naslov: Kimi K3.1 Pro: the almost-open model that reached the top of the leaderboard
opis:
Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3.1 Pro in its API, a mixture-of-experts model (one that activates only part of itself for each token) with 2.8 trillion parameters, 104 billion of them active, and a one-million-token context.

Why it matters: For apps that need a top-tier model, this is a cheaper alternative with an OpenAI-compatible API.

naslov: Claude wrote 180 million lines of proof that existing code is correct
opis:
Anthropic's Frontier Red Team, together with Theorem Labs, had Claude write formal proofs (mathematical checks that a machine verifies) that code in 123 open-source libraries does what it should. The result was about 180 million lines of proof covering 239 entry points.

Why it matters: Formal verification has been expensive and rare.
